answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. A bridge of per-task receipts records who did what, and the quill of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. By the onyx of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
